image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle view of a beige audio cassette tape against a blue background. The cassette features two visible spools with magnetic tape, a rectangular opening at the bottom for the player head, and various molded plastic details like screw holes and write-protect tabs. There is a label area with text that appears to be gibberish or stylized non-Latin characters. The image has a soft, slightly painterly or digital illustration aesthetic rather than a photorealistic one.
